**Blocking finding — SOL-S2-R1-1, P2: observe service-site departure while panels are closed.**

The sole context comparison/reset is in [src/ui/panels.ts:71](../../../src/ui/panels.ts#L71)–76, inside `PanelView.refresh`. Ordinary gameplay calls [GameView.update:371](../../../src/ui/view.ts#L371)–374, which updates only HUD presentation. `refreshPanel` calls the panel owner only with an open panel ([view.ts:396](../../../src/ui/view.ts#L396)–399); the app's frame path likewise has no storage-context observer ([app.ts:335](../../../src/runtime/app.ts#L335)–338). Thus a site → field → same-site trip is invisible to storage memory. Both endpoints have the same anchor, so reopening Hold preserves the earlier explicit source/destination instead of returning to contextual defaults. This contradicts the explicit [2C storage lifetime contract](../tasks/POLISH-1-SLICE2-2C.md): “Leaving that site or session replacement resets context.”

Reproduction on the actual final production bundle, CSS960×600:

1. Import the unchanged earned workshop return `/tmp/siltwake-polish-1-slice2-2d-hud/release/earned-refuge-before-reload.json` (SHA256 `81a363a1a5ff5f5b22b0db7426e7f3d9299dcd7b19811afec299418dd1ab017a`). Open Hold at the restored workshop. Its implicit destination is Workshop locker; deliberately select Dart hold.
2. Close Hold. Move away and return with no panel open en route. My bounded production-handler continuation held D for1500ms, recorded an actual F5 save outside the site at `(20.233717091634148,-0.5010837796160712,-34.98060053336131)` in swimming mode, then used A+Space for1850ms to return. No grants, relocation or direct game-state setters were used.
3. Reopen Hold. The HUD reports workshop air and the camera settles at `(14.305,2.820,-35.560)`, but the destination remains Dart hold. [Actual capture](/tmp/siltwake-polish-1-slice2-sol-r1/storage-after-leave-return-960.png), [full away export](/tmp/siltwake-polish-1-slice2-sol-r1/storage-away-export.json), [return/native observations](/tmp/siltwake-polish-1-slice2-sol-r1/storage-return-probe.json).

The separate [current-production GameView diagnostic](/tmp/siltwake-polish-1-slice2-sol-r1/storage-lifetime-probe.mjs) reproduces the same result and supplies the control case: opening Notebook while away causes the return to default to Workshop locker. [Result](/tmp/siltwake-polish-1-slice2-sol-r1/storage-lifetime-result.json). The existing lifetime test opens Notebook away at [tests/preparation-panels.test.ts:180](../../../tests/preparation-panels.test.ts#L180); it never exercises ordinary closed-panel travel.

Player consequence: the next outing/refit inherits an earlier source/destination depending on unrelated menu history. A later bulk-store action can therefore target a different accessible hold than the required fresh-site default. Labels and command validation remain truthful, so this is neither inventory corruption nor an automatic transfer, but the specified intent boundary is absent in the normal travel path. Observe site context during ordinary state updates, independently of panel rendering, while retaining same-site roster/bench/cradle continuity. Add a meaningful closed-panel departure/return regression through GameView/app, plus the existing same-site preservation controls. No fix was made by this reviewer.
